11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL lightness modulation across hierarchy depths shows real design intent, and the header/breadcrumb/legend/chart composition is clean — held back from 8 by some smaller leaf cells feeling cramped and the legend swatches not visually connecting to the treemap's depth-modulated hues.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct (treemap area ∝ file size via .sum()), domains are layout-derived and data-driven, key function present — docked for stateful RNG called inside cellFill causing non-deterministic leaf colors on re-render, and the key string (name+depth+parentName) risks collisions for same-named files in the same subdirectory.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: Click-based zoom correctly calls .interrupt() before transitions and avoids update storms, but uses no pointer-event filter to prevent mobile scroll/tap conflicts triggering accidental zoom.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: 8-color Tol palette sits at the warning threshold but is perceptually distinct, hierarchy is legible at root with smart label suppression for tiny cells, and zoom-to-drill-down offloads depth complexity rather than overwhelming the viewer all at once.
